posts.headline: One Nut Barner is closing in on a full month of silence, and Put it in Ra's absurd 20-8 career mark with a 1.5 average finish and ZERO rings is now the longest-running crime scene in this league's history.
posts.detail: Best résumé in Busters Anonymous by a mile, back-to-back top-two finishes, and yet the draft board says nothing. At some point silence stops being humble and starts being suspicious.

posts.headline: Draft night is here and Big Head has officially run out of editions to explain how a title banner hangs over a 13-15 career record.
posts.detail: Sasinci's World carries the tier-one 'contender' label off one ring, but a losing career mark and a 5.5 average finish say the fluke jury is about to deliver its verdict live at the podium.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh takes the podium tonight still holding the single worst résumé in the league, and nothing suggests the untalented tenth found a scouting department overnight.
posts.detail: A 4-10 record and a dead-last 12th-place finish built this nickname brick by brick — draft night is Chauncey's one shot to argue otherwise, and the smart money says he won't take it.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT drafts for real tonight, and the Ultimate Light Skin is one bad pick away from re-committing the DEFENSIVE-player-first-overall sin this league will never let him forget.
posts.detail: A 13-14-1 career record and a 5.5 average finish is the definition of purgatory — Eli, it's time to choose the Bible or the Belt, because middling forever isn't an option this league accepts anymore.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy Way or the Hard Way walks into draft night off a 10th-place, 6-8 rookie season, and Auntie Thomas needs an actual roster, not just the voice, to escape the basement.
posts.detail: A bottom-feeder tier with a 10th-place finish in year one isn't a fluke, it's a foundation — and this league has seen zero evidence that changes tonight.
